summary: Frontend-only test of HPP Kalkulator instant stok updates. Optimistic UI fix on Jual works perfectly (stok 10→7 within ~152ms, well under 500ms). Backend and UI stay consistent. Tambah Stok Cepat also updates instantly (~105ms). BUG FOUND: deleting a nota restores stok on the backend (15) but the UI table still shows the pre-delete value (12) because hapusNota() does not call refresh() to reload products.

ui_bugs.issue: After deleting a sale/nota, backend restores stok (+qty) but the Stok column in HPP table is NOT refreshed. UI shows stale value until user manually reloads or refetches. onSold->reload only refreshes App-level (transactions/records), not HPPKalkulator's rows/products state.

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly $inc stok +qty in DELETE /api/sales/{id}, but frontend does not re-fetch products after deletion. Need to call refresh() (or optimistic setRows) in hapusNota, and ideally also in App.reload chain so linked components stay in sync.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/HPPKalkulator.jsx hapusNota(), add optimistic setRows to bump stok back by s.qty when s.product_id exists, then await refresh() so table & backend re-sync. Example fix: after api.deleteSale, do setRows(rs => rs.map(x => x.id === s.product_id ? { ...x, stok: (parseInt(x.stok,10)||0) + s.qty } : x)); await refresh();
critical_code_review_comments: hapusNota() lacks refresh()/optimistic stok restore — inconsistent with confirmJual/confirmTambahStok which both refresh.

HPPKalkulator is 547 lines — consider splitting Jual dialog, Tambah Stok dialog, Salin Margin dialog, Report dialog, and Riwayat Nota into separate components for maintainability (>700 line guideline; approaching threshold and already dense).

confirmJual: on backend failure the optimistic setRows still runs before await; since createSale is awaited BEFORE setRows the current order is safe, but if network is slow the UI update is delayed until server responds — could be moved BEFORE createSale for true optimism (and rolled back on failure).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 temporary Branding product (Produk Baru, harga 50000, stok 10) then cleaned up: sale deleted via UI + product deleted via DELETE /api/products/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary optimistic-update fix on Jual is confirmed working (152ms instant update, persists post-refresh, matches backend). Only remaining failure: hapusNota does not visually restore stok. After main agent adds optimistic setRows + refresh() in hapusNota, re-run the delete-nota portion of iteration_3 test: create product stok=10, jual qty=3 -> confirm stok=7, delete the created nota, poll hpp-stok-<id> to become 10 within <500ms and confirm backend GET /api/products returns stok=10.
rca of the issue: hapusNota in HPPKalkulator.jsx (lines 165-171) only removes the sale from local sales state and calls parent onSold (App.reload). App.reload does NOT re-fetch products; only HPPKalkulator.refresh() does. Therefore rows[] retains the post-sale stok value (12) even though DB has 15. Fix: add optimistic setRows for product_id and/or await refresh() inside hapusNota.
